name: Waldcafe
beschreibung: The Waldcafe is quietly situated at the edge of a mountain village in Tirol, surrounded by forest and meadows. The interior combines alpine coziness with modern comfort – wood paneling, warm colors, and large windows shape the ambiance. Guests can expect spacious rooms, a restaurant serving regional cuisine, and a sun terrace with mountain views. In winter, there is access to ski slopes; in summer, direct hiking opportunities into the surrounding countryside. Families and nature lovers will find a relaxed retreat here.
